faq.q: Is my text sent to a server?

faq.a: With the default options it replaces every run of spaces or tabs with a single space and trims the start and end of each line. Your words and line breaks are never changed.
No. Line breaks are preserved (unless you also drop blank lines). To join lines into paragraphs, use Remove Line Breaks instead.
faq.q: Will it join my lines together?

metaDescription: Clean up messy text: collapse double spaces, trim every line and drop blank lines. Free extra-space remover — private, runs in your browser.
title: Remove Extra Spaces from Text — Free Online Tool | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: It can't fix spacing inside code or tables where columns are aligned with spaces — collapsing those spaces destroys the alignment.
It standardises spacing only; it won't correct punctuation spacing conventions that differ by style guide (such as French double-space after periods, which is outdated anyway).
